meta.title: Paper vs Live Parity Verification
meta.epic: 10 - Live Trading Production Readiness & Lighter.xyz Integration

story-context.story-summary: Verify that paper trading behavior matches live trading behavior for order submission, position calculations, PnL, and state transitions.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: Order submission calls have identical parameters between paper and live
Position calculations use same logic (size, entry price, direction)
PnL calculations produce identical results for same fill prices
State transitions follow the same state machine
Parity report documents any intentional differences

key-tasks.task: Create parity test infrastructure with mock live broker
Implement order call comparison (capture and compare parameters)
Implement PnL calculation comparison with Decimal precision
Create parity report documenting expected differences
Test edge cases (partial fills, cancellation, reversals)

architecture-context.pattern: Both paper and live brokers implement same BrokerAdapter ABC, ensuring identical method signatures, return types, exception types.
architecture-context.constraint: Paper trading must be a faithful simulation of live trading

technical-specifications.spec: 1. Fill source: Paper simulates locally, live receives from exchange 2. Network latency: Paper has no network latency 3. Slippage: Paper uses configured model, live has real slippage 4. Partial fills: Live may have partial fills, paper depends on config
